eval_dimensions.name: Next-Steps AskUserQuestion Gate
eval_dimensions.description: After presenting the deferred-items report, the skill fires AskUserQuestion (resume continuation prompt / pick a task / migrate legacy TODO.md / just informational) whenever at least one source returned items — never a plain-text 'what would you like to do?'.

evals.name: Next-steps gate fires when any source returns items
evals.description: When the task index, legacy TODO.md, code TODOs, PR bookmarks, Slack reminders, or memory notes return at least one item, the skill fires AskUserQuestion after presenting the report.

assertions.signal: At least one deferred item found → AskUserQuestion fires with resume/pick/migrate/close options
No inline plain-text 'what next?' substitutes for the widget when items were found

evals.name: Next-steps gate does not fire when every source is empty
evals.description: When every section renders '(none)' — no task index entries, no legacy TODO, no code TODOs, no PR bookmarks, no Slack reminders, no memory notes — the skill does not fire the gate.

assertions.signal: All sources empty → report renders with '(none)' sections; AskUserQuestion is not called

evals.name: No chained/raw-CLI anti-patterns from the Commands table
evals.description: The skill never issues chained Bash (';'/'&&'/subshells), a bare 'cat'/'grep' in place of Read/Grep, or a raw 'gh pr view --json comments' in place of the pr_comments MCP wrapper.

assertions.signal: PR bookmark lookup uses mcp__plugin_Dev10x_cli__pr_detect + pr_comments, never raw gh api/gh pr view

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the park-discover skill

should_trigger.rationale: Direct invocation to gather deferred items across all sources
Session-start discovery request — the core use case

should_trigger.query: any open items to pick up

should_not_trigger.query: remember to check the retry logic later
should_not_trigger.rationale: Writing a new deferral — use Dev10x:park-todo or Dev10x:park, not park-discover
No need to check deferred items during active work
